youtube.title: Pet Khaali Ho Toh Hi Kyun Garajta Hai? 🫃 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Aapka pet isliye nahi garajta ki use bhookh lagi hai. Woh isliye garajta hai kyunki woh khaali hai. Din bhar aapki gut ki muscles squeeze hoti rehti hain aur khaana, gas aur liquid ko aage dhakelti hain.

Khaane ke lagbhag do ghante baad gut ek cleaning wave shuru karti hai jo bacha hua khaana saaf karti hai. Ab awaaz dabane ke liye kuch bacha nahi hota, toh gas aur liquid zor se gurgle karte hain. Yaani woh garaj bas aapke pet ka kachra nikalna hai.

The Hidden Why ka Hindi edition: roz ki cheezon ke peeche ki asli wajah.
